US-CHINA ROBOTICS DECOUPLING BEGINS

Bernstein says the FCC ban on new foreign-made mobile robots marks the start of U.S.-China robotics decoupling.

Restrictions could expand to AI chips and investments, while China could retaliate through data controls or rare-earth magnets.
